note.surprise_finding: qa5/8k mem_space partial 85% > Beacon-Qwen2-7B 63%. Why: chunked path generates verbose 'According to the text, X gave Y to Z' answers that contain target entity name as substring. qa5 targets are person/item names (single words) so substring match liberal. qa1 targets are location words (also liberal). qa2 needs multi-fact reasoning so verbose answers often miss correct target.
note.implication: previous qa1/8k=39% 'failure' is partly substring-match strictness on chunked verbose output, not real semantic failure. Need lenient match (any candidate location word) for fair comparison.

note.story_update: qa5/32k mem_space 30%p vs vanilla 0%p → +30% win extension to 32k. qa2 vanilla 0-4k filled in: 44/41/47/44%. Vanilla < Beacon by 13-23% on qa2 short context (8B-Inst weaker than Qwen2-7B-Inst on multi-fact). Our mem_space ≈ vanilla on qa2 0-4k (small loss)

note.discovery: qa5/8k mem_space=86 > vanilla=72p → +14 win on QA5 8k against own vanilla, not just vs Beacon

note.key_insight: strict substring match was over-counting qa5 because 'Fred', 'apple', 'milk', 'kitchen' etc are short tokens that frequently appear in verbose chunked-path output regardless of correct answer. Lenient (first-candidate-in-output) is more honest. qa5 strict 86/67/44 → lenient 31/22/21. Win still holds but more realistic.

note.verdict: SMOKING GUN found + verified in code. Two bugs sever the memory learning loop:
note.bug1: memory_bank.py:300-304 (dual-gate) & ~358 (replace): slot_value_norm_cap=5.0 runs `self.slots = self.slots/scale_all` INSIDE torch.no_grad() -> rebinds self.slots to a DETACHED tensor. write() returns gradient-bearing `updated` (recon uses it within-chunk OK) but the STORED self.slots that chunk2 reads is detached -> cross-chunk gradient SEVERED. Verified: cap=5.0->requires_grad=False, cap=0->True. This is why write+route work but answer-token grad cannot teach chunk1 write. bptt_window=2 credit assignment never actually worked.
note.bug2: inject_gate (nn.Linear, layer.py:400, produces per-token fusion gate g) is NOT in _mem_space_params (train script L168-209) -> frozen at init g~0.46, model cannot learn to rely more on memory. Verified: not collected.
note.mask_OK: answer token CAN attend memory (mask fine, memory changes logits by 312). routing OK. write content OK (recon~0.001).

★Landmark训练配方(landmark-researcher,LLaMA-7B fine-tune版): (1)FULL model微调无冻结无LoRA(FSDP全shard,embed+attn+FFN+landmark token全训);(2)15k步1epoch lr2e-5 cosine+3%warmup wd0.1 AdamW bf16,eff-batch128,RedPajama,ctx512 block50;(3)grouped-softmax纯端到端LM loss学选块无aux loss(靠softmax分组强制local vs landmark权衡);(4)无attention-only/单层解冻先例,他们只做过full FT;(5)★关键OOD洞察: Landmark无分布失配是BY CONSTRUCTION——它从不注入外部产生的KV,检索块是同一forward同一grouped-softmax产生的activation,模型端到端训练在用的就是推理用的注入/选择路径. →直接解释我们oracle失败: 我们把KV注入冻结模型从没训过consume的attention路径=OOD. Landmark教训: 必须端到端训练在注入机制上,注入KV在loss-bearing forward里(梯度路径,非detached),且解冻足够多让模型recalibrate到注入分布. 我们的unfreeze实验设计: (a)注入KV路径训练时必须live in-graph非detached;(b)full FT是evidence-backed安全选择,单层/q-k-v-only解冻unproven是我们自己的ablation风险. 待与用户对齐解冻范围(最小探路vs full FT)后派coder.

TRAINING时train.py→forward past_key_values=None→走else(432-439): 单512-window内dense grouped-softmax(469),无top_k无块检索. ★即Landmark从不训练retriever——landmark token经grouped-softmax学成per-block gist-gate key,top_k检索是inference时train-free复用这些key的trick. 我们mem_space相反: 训练一个显式cross-window selector(实测0% needle precision). ★所以'检索'轴底下藏着真正的轴: train-time-emergent-selection(Landmark,work) vs trained-explicit-selector(我们,坏). ★推论: S4(换scorer为学习selector头)无法作为单轴在锚点实现——(a)训练forward根本不跑检索路径,学习头拿不到梯度;(b)要让它训练须改成multi-window训练让检索路径fire=动S3 ctx结构=第二轴;(c)landmark token既是被打分对象又是块的key(scorer与memory-unit是同一物),换scorer必重定义块key=动S6. →决策OPTION2: Group-B从S4重排到S3(train-time multi-window context)先行,S3是让可训练selable的前提且本身干净单轴+顶级嫌疑. note.note: ★Level 0单块in-context上限(methodA-eval,地基确认): needle+question同一512chunk无跨块/注入/RoPE操纵,vanilla base Llama-3-8B=100% / mem_space h1fix reader=96%. →基础readout能力完全OK不是墙(排除'一直在弱readout base上测长程'担心). 对照跨块W0 4k=11-14%: 同一reader,needle与question不同chunk经注入路径到达就崩≤14%. ★墙精确定位: reader能窗口内读出但跨块(经注入路径)读不出. ★★今天所有线收束同一侧+双重独立印证: methodA-eval consumption墙(go/no-go选对55%也答不出+Level0单窗100%跨块14%) 与 landmark-repro S5(单层读出0% vs全层78-100%) 撞到同一结论=跨块读出是真瓶颈+需多层覆盖. ★下一步Level 1 distance×注入层数矩阵: 真实needle raw-KV注入近处vs远处 × 注入层数(L16/L16-20-24/更多层),一次回答(a)distance/RoPE vs readout能力 (b)层覆盖是否跨块读出杠杆(验S5在mem_space侧). 定下个正式实验=距离修法 or 多层注入+跨块读出训练. landmark-repro并行调研Landmark全层读出机制(per-layer独立vs共享)互补.

note.detail: ★Level 0 单块 in-context 上限 = GO(地基稳): h1fix ckpt,chunk_size=8192(整 doc 一个 native window,无分块/无注入/无 raw-KV/无 RoPE 操纵),qa1 4k=74% 8k=59%. vs chunk512 memory readout 4k=14% 8k=7%. ⇒ (1) reader readout 基础能力 OK(74%>>70%阈值),能做长程单 needle QA——当内容在 native window 内. (2) 墙明确是跨块消费: needle 被切到独立 chunk 走 memory/raw-KV 路径时 reader 用不了(14/7). NOT base readout 无能,NOT selection(55% precision 够). 是 injected/memory-routed KV 没像 native-window KV 那样被消费. 与 S5 单层0%断崖(层覆盖)+ oracle≈OFF 历史一致. 注: 4k单块74%非~95%,有些退化(疑8192 window vs 512训练窗 OOD,或qa1难度),但远超死线21、过>70%门槛. → 进 Level 1(距离 vs 跨块机制 probe).

note.note: ★mem_space多层修复设计草案(landmark-repro,commit MEM_SPACE_MULTILAYER_FIX_DESIGN.md)关键发现细化根因: Method A当前已是多层readout(16/20/24)+unfreeze L16-31仍崩→'单层→多层'杠杆已部分开却没救回→必须把(A)层覆盖广度 和 (B)训练目标 解耦. ★判断(B)训练目标很可能是被忽视真凶: Landmark全序列LM loss让reader在每个位置练'从历史KV生成token',我们--last_chunk_loss_only只末块算loss→reader从没被训练跨块读出. 与go/no-go'选对也读不出'完美对上: reader不是读不出,是从没被训练过跨块读出. landmark-repro确认Landmark passkey是真end-to-end答对(generate+exact match非retrieval)→Landmark reader确学会跨块消费,差异在训练方式. ★代码盘点: 多层注入(每层自己k/v_proj+RoPE重投影=每层独立读出非复制)/任意层集合/多层解冻全已支持0改动纯配置; 缺全序列跨块loss(~30-50行,选'滑动target chunk'省算力). ★对照臂单轴拆: A0单层16(复现S5 mem_space版)/A1 16-20-24(现状anchor崩)/A2全上半16-31 last_chunk(纯测层覆盖A)/B1 16-20-24全序列loss(纯测训练目标B)/B2 16-31+全序列(组合上限). ★决策: A2立即起(纯配置不等Level1,Group-A空), B1写loss+CPU smoke验跨块梯度非死参数+等Level1. methodA-eval Level1加last_chunk on/off臂与B轴对齐避免重跑. 这是从诊断转修复第一个正式实验.

★mem_space多层修复实验 ARM A2(层覆盖轴)起训. A2=RETRAIN非eval-only(架构定:检索KV经每层自己native k/v_proj消费,layer必须在concat路径上被训过;A1 ckpt只16/20/24见过raw-KV,加17-31需重训否则OOD). 单轴vs A1: 仅--rawkv_readout_layers 16,20,24→16-31(全上半16层),其余held=Method A h1fix配方(unfreeze L16-31, last_chunk_loss_only, T2+pg19, gist_pool max, topk2, lr2e-5, 2000步save500). 本机8×H20 FSDP. RUN=mem_space_A2_readout16to31_diskA. step4健康: 32层wrap, gist proj grad_norm0.11-0.19, GPU100%, 无OOM/error. judge=W0 qa1 passkey同methodA-eval口径,目标8k/16k从≤7爬升. 配A0(单层16=S5复现)/A1(16/20/24 anchor)对照. B1(全序列跨块loss)待写码+Level1.

note.detail: ★★Level 1 决定性: 注入正确 needle raw-KV(bypass 选择,store 只放 needle chunk)+ col_bias=0,reader 读出率 = L16 near87.5/far82.5, L16/20/24 near97.5/far95, L16/20/24/28 & L16-31 near97.5/far97.5. → (1) 不是 distance/RoPE 问题(far≈near). (2) 不是 consumption 无能(reader 给对内容能读出97.5%). (3) 多层注入小幅提升(单层82-87→多层97.5)+ 印证 S5 方向但单层已能 82%(没断崖,与 S5 LLaMA1 单层0%不同,可能 Llama3/rawkv 路径差异). ★关键 reframe: reader CAN 消费跨块 raw-KV(给对就能读). 那 W0 崩(≤14%)+ col_bias=0 go/no-go 崩(4k11/8k5)的真因 = store 里放了全部16 chunk(8192 token raw-KV),reader native attn 在 16×512 列里被稀释/找不到 needle,不是读不出. 即: 瓶颈回到'从大量 raw-KV 里 isolate needle chunk'——55% chunk 选对不够,需要更强 isolate/up-weight. 下一步验证: Level1 改成 full 16-chunk haystack store(非只 needle)看读出率是否崩——若崩则坐实'稀释'是真因,且 trained selection(把 needle chunk 喂干净)反而可能有救(与之前 H2 张力,需调和).
